queries: Creed gets arrested at the office

bullet_facts.fact: Creed is involved in a situation where police are tipped off about a narcotics situation at the office.
Creed is shown to be arrested at the office during an episode.
In one scene, Creed stands up and puts his hands up as the police arrive.
Creed states, 'Just doing my job, guys,' when questioned about his actions.
Creed's arrest is depicted in multiple episodes, including S05E08, S04E02, S03E20, S02E05, S07E24, and S07E10.

supporting_quotes.quote: Creed stands up and starts to put him hands up and then relaxes them behind his ears
Michael: Those are real cops, real guns. I wonder what's going on.
Creed: Just doing my job, guys.
